description: Comparison-record scenario matrix (tests/FAILURE-PROPAGATION-CONTRACT.md, Comparison record). Rows carry specimen inputs, the raw channel inputs for the Swift unit reader, the raw fields the live reader asserts beside the record, the independent control, and the expected current-response comparison object.

placeholders.SCEN_ROOT: absolute directory the live reader creates under /private/tmp; the unit reader substitutes any fixed absolute string
placeholders.STUB_VALIDATOR: absolute path of stub_validator.py beside this fixture
placeholders.FIFO: the FIFO the deadline case creates under /private/tmp

query_column_rule: sandbox_check.outcome when result_source is validator and the outcome is allow or deny; otherwise unavailable

unit_reader.inputs: unit.sandbox_check and unit.attempt are PWRunnerSandboxCheckResult and PWRunnerAttemptResult field values; unit.query_exclusion_reason and unit.order are the comparisonEvidence(...) arguments
unit_reader.lifecycle: append PWDisposition.limitationForSummary[unit.lifecycle_summary] (nothing for completed) to the rendered limitations, as buildStepResults does
unit_reader.assert_value_conventions: ">0" means any positive integer; null means the field is absent or JSON null (the Swift encoder omits nil optionals)

locked.effect: unchanged bytes; the live reader restores a readable mode before removing it

writable.effect: truncated by S24's open_write (O_WRONLY|O_TRUNC), which then writes one byte: present, 1 byte after the run

created.effect: present after the run: created by S08

unlink_s19.effect: absent after the run: unlinked by S19 before S25 reads it

helper_locked.effect: unchanged bytes; the live reader restores a readable mode before removing it

unlink_b3.effect: absent after the run: unlinked by B3

unlink_b6.effect: absent after the run: unlinked by B6 after B5 reads it

expected.note: every emitted stub record is associated; b1, b6 and b7 retain query_first; a short batch followed by clean EOF would instead produce validator_unavailable
